get_data: parse a JSON file of DFT and force field data points into CO2 and H2O lists
get_Fig4a: generate a histogram of raw FF minus DFT error distributions for CO2 and H2O
get_Fig4b: generate a binned average error bar plot with KDE density overlay for CO2 and H2O
get_Fig4c: generate a density-colored scatter plot of DFT interaction energy versus absolute error for CO2
phys_err: compute the mean absolute error for physisorption regime where DFT energies are between 0 and negative 0.5 eV
